presentation.description: How the screen appears: `page` replaces the previous one, `modal` is a layer on top of it. No field means `page` — the way screens behaved before 8.12.0.

modalPlacement.description: Where the modal layer lies (9.9.0): `bottom` — a sheet pinned to the bottom edge, `center` — a window in the middle of the screen. Read only when `presentation` is `modal`. No field means `bottom`. Geometry, scrim and dismissal are data: «x-style.layout.modalLayer».

statusBarIcons.description: A REQUEST to the host about the system status bar while this screen is shown (9.9.0): `light` — light icons (the screen is dark under them), `dark` — dark icons. The reader never touches the system bar: it hands the request over in the «screen shown» event («x-statusBar»). No field — no request, the host decides.

backdropBlur.description: Blur of everything under the modal layer (9.20.0): the screens below with their app bar and navigation bar, in logical pixels — the standard deviation of a Gaussian blur. The scrim lies over the blur. Read only when `presentation` is `modal`. No field — no blur, exactly as before 9.20.0. Rules — «x-backdropBlur».

dismissible.description: Only on a modal screen (9.26.0): «false» — the layer waits for an action inside it. No drag down, no tap on the scrim and no Esc close it; the system back stays with the host and «navigate.back» inside the layer works. No field — the layer is dismissed as «x-style.layout.modalLayer.dismiss» and «x-sheetDismiss» say.

align.description: Where the children of the screen root that do not stretch stand across the screen (a node with its own «style.width» and the widgets of «x-style.layout.column.naturalWidth»): «start» — the start of the script (the right edge in RTL), «center», «end». Stretched children keep the full width. No field — «start», the screen as it was before 9.15.0. It is the cross alignment of the root column («x-style.layout.column.naturalWidthAlign»), so a pinned block of natural width follows it too; the app bar and the navigation bar always take the full width.

justify.description: How the children of the BODY are placed from top to bottom when the content is shorter than the visible body (the area between the app bar and the bottom zone): «start», «center», «end», «between». Content taller than the body scrolls as before and the field changes nothing. Only the children of the body take part: the app bar, the pinned block and the navigation bar do not. No field — «start». Rules — «x-style.layout.alignment.screen».

contentMaxWidth.description: The largest width of the CONTENT of the screen, in logical pixels (9.18.0). The background of the root and of the zones (app bar, bottom zone) runs edge to edge; the content of the app bar, of the body and of the bottom zone is a column no wider than this number, centred — the same in LTR and RTL. A screen narrower than the number is not changed. No field — the content takes the full width, as before 9.18.0. Rules — «x-style.layout.widthClass.contentMaxWidth». A reader older than 9.18.0 skips the field.

bodyTop.description: Where the BODY area of the screen starts (9.19.0). Without the field — at the bottom edge of the app bar (without an app bar — below the top safe inset): the screen as it was before 9.19.0. «screenTop» — at the top edge of the screen: the body lies UNDER the app bar and under the status bar, the app bar stays fixed in its place OVER the body and takes the presses in its box, and scrolled content shows through an app bar without a background. Nothing else changes: only the body scrolls. Rules — «x-style.layout.bodyTop» and «x-style.layout.safeTop». No field or an unknown word — the screen as before 9.19.0. A reader older than 9.19.0 skips the field and draws the app bar as a strip above the body.

SpacingToken.description: Name of a «spacing» token of the project theme. The schema checks only the shape of the name; whether the theme declares it is a semantic rule checked against the active theme.

fontStyle.description: Slant of the text (9.17.0). Inherited down the tree like «typography»; read by Text only. «normal» cancels an inherited italic.

textDecoration.description: Line under or through the text (9.17.0), in the colour of the text. Inherited down the tree; read by Text only. «none» cancels an inherited line.

textGradient.description: Gradient painted on the GLYPHS of the text (9.23.0): a gradient token of the theme or an own gradient of the same form as a gradient «background». It lies over the whole content box of the text, not line by line; a part of the text that names its own colour keeps it. «color» stays the fallback: an older reader and a gradient that does not resolve paint the text with it. Not inherited; read by Text only. Rules — «x-textGradient».

backdropBlur.description: Blur of whatever is painted UNDER the box of this node, clipped by its «radius» (9.20.0) — frosted glass on a card, a navigation bar or a button. Logical pixels, the standard deviation of a Gaussian blur; the node own background lies over the blur, the node and its children are never blurred. Not inherited. No field — no blur. Rules — «x-backdropBlur.style».

ColorToken.description: Name of a «color» token of the project theme. The schema checks only the shape of the name; whether the theme declares it is a semantic rule checked against the active theme.

TypographyToken.description: Name of a «typography» token of the project theme. The schema checks only the shape of the name; whether the theme declares it is a semantic rule checked against the active theme.

GradientToken.description: Name of a «gradient» token of the project theme. The schema checks only the shape of the name; whether the theme declares it is a semantic rule checked against the active theme.

RadiusToken.description: Name of a «radius» token of the project theme. The schema checks only the shape of the name; whether the theme declares it is a semantic rule checked against the active theme.

style.description: Line of the border (9.22.0). «dashed» — dashes of 3 and gaps of 2 border widths along the centre line of the border, following the corner arcs; the count closes the loop evenly. Rules — «x-style.layout.borderDash». No field or an unknown word — solid, exactly as before 9.22.0.

ElevationToken.description: Name of a «elevation» token of the project theme. The schema checks only the shape of the name; whether the theme declares it is a semantic rule checked against the active theme.

ShadowColor.description: Colour of the shadow (9.25.0): «background» — every layer of «shadow» (a token or own layers) takes the hue of the own background of this node, keeping the opacity of the layer: a solid background gives its colour, a gradient the stop nearest to its middle. No background, an image background or a colour that does not resolve — the shadow keeps its own colour. Rules — «x-shadowColor». No field — the shadow keeps its own colour, exactly as before 9.25.0.

valuePath.description: The operand is the value under this OTHER data path (9.23.0), read in the same scope as «path»: «reward.category eq ui.rewardsCategory». No value under it (or the empty string) — see «x-listFilter.operandMissing».

item.description: Prefix of a record of the collection, as «Repeater.item» (9.23.0).

where.description: Count only the records for which this condition holds (9.23.0) — the same predicate as «Repeater.where». Rules — «x-listFilter.emptiness».

ScreenStyleOn.description: The same as «StyleOn», for the screen root: no «margin» and no sizes.

ScreenStyleUnset.description: The same as «StyleUnset», for the style of the screen root.

ScreenPropsOn.description: Layout properties of the node on wider screens (9.18.0) — a CLOSED list per widget («x-style.layout.widthClass.props.byWidget»); content (texts, actions, data sources, icons) is never overridden. Resolved from narrow to wide: «props», then «medium» when the class is medium or expanded, then «expanded» when the class is expanded; a key the layer does not name keeps the value below. Same types and limits as the base property, except «columns», which takes 1…6 here. No field — «props» on every width. A reader older than 9.18.0 skips the field and draws the base.

ScreenPropsUnset.description: The same as «StyleUnset», for the layout properties.

styleScrolled.description: Style of this app bar while the body is scrolled (9.21.0): «background», «color», «shadow» and «backdropBlur» only — nothing that changes the box. The layer lies LAST, over the state of «styleWhen»; the threshold and when it applies — «x-style.layout.appBarScrolled». No field — the bar does not change on scroll, exactly as before 9.21.0.

titleAlign.description: Where the title block stands (9.16.0): «center» — in the centre of the bar while it fits (the rule of 9.9.0), «start» — right after the leading zone, lines aligned to the start; logical, mirrored in right-to-left scripts. Rules — «x-style.layout.appBarTitle». No field — «center», exactly as before 9.16.0.

titleShown.description: When the title block is drawn (9.21.0). «scrolled» — only while the body is scrolled («x-style.layout.appBarScrolled»); at rest it is not drawn but keeps its place, so the zones do not jump. No field or an unknown word — always, exactly as before 9.21.0.

pad.description: At least this many digits, zeros in front («05»), beside «format: countdownPart» (9.21.0). No field — as many digits as the number has.

values.description: Named values of the template. A name is substituted where the template says `{name}`; a value the template does not mention is allowed.

CurrencyCode.description: An ISO 4217 currency code: three capital letters (USD, JOD). Required exactly when `format` is `currency`.

CurrencyDisplay.description: Money (9.19.0): `symbol` shows the currency by its sign from «x-money.symbols» instead of the code. A code the table does not have is shown as the code. Only with `format: currency`. No field — the code.

CurrencyPosition.description: Money (9.19.0): `before` puts the currency before the amount — a sign with no gap, a code with U+00A0. Only with `format: currency`. No field — after the amount, with U+00A0.

NumberSign.description: Sign of a number (9.19.0): `always` writes «+» before a positive number. Zero has no sign. With `format: number` or `currency`. No field — a negative number only, as the platform writes it.

DateParts.description: Which parts of a date to show, beside «format: date» (9.19.0): «dayMonth» — day and month in full, no year; «weekdayDayMonth» — the day of the week, day and month in full; «dayMonthYear» — day, month in full and year. Order and separators come from CLDR for the formatting locale. Rules — «x-dateParts». No field — year, short month and day, exactly as before 9.19.0. A word the reader does not know — the field is absent.

CountdownUnit.description: Which part of the time left the «countdownPart» format shows (9.21.0): «days» — whole days; «hours» — 0–23; «minutes» — 0–59; «seconds» — 0–59. Required exactly when «format» is «countdownPart». Arithmetic, ticking and the clock — «x-countdown».

NumberNotation.description: Compact number (9.23.0): «compact» writes 48 200 as «48.2K» (en) or «48,2 тис.» (uk) — one fraction digit, half up, suffixes from a closed table by language. Only with «format: number». Rules — «x-compactNumber». No field — every digit.

pad.description: At least this many digits, zeros in front («05»), beside «format: countdownPart» (9.21.0). No field — as many digits as the number has.

PluralForms.description: Forms of a word next to a number, in the default language of the document, keyed by CLDR plural category. Translations live in `localization.strings` under `<place>.values.<name>.forms.<category>`.

fontStyle.description: Slant of the text (9.17.0). Inherited down the tree like «typography»; read by Text only. «normal» cancels an inherited italic.

textDecoration.description: Line under or through the text (9.17.0), in the colour of the text. Inherited down the tree; read by Text only. «none» cancels an inherited line.

textGradient.description: Gradient painted on the GLYPHS of the text (9.23.0): a gradient token of the theme or an own gradient of the same form as a gradient «background». It lies over the whole content box of the text, not line by line; a part of the text that names its own colour keeps it. «color» stays the fallback: an older reader and a gradient that does not resolve paint the text with it. Not inherited; read by Text only. Rules — «x-textGradient».

backdropBlur.description: Blur of whatever is painted UNDER the box of this node, clipped by its «radius» (9.20.0) — frosted glass on a card, a navigation bar or a button. Logical pixels, the standard deviation of a Gaussian blur; the node own background lies over the blur, the node and its children are never blurred. Not inherited. No field — no blur. Rules — «x-backdropBlur.style».

NodeWeight.description: Share of the row width this child takes. Children with a weight split the row in proportion to their weights; children without one keep their natural width. A weight overrides the widget own width. Legal only inside a row of finite width: the «Row» widget without «wrap» and without «scrollable», or a «Container» with direction «row». No field — the child keeps its natural width, exactly as before 8.17.0.

NodeLayer.description: Placement of this layer inside a «Stack» (9.10.0). A layer with this field is an OVERLAY: it is positioned against the box of the stack and never changes the size of the stack. «alignHorizontal» / «alignVertical» — its own alignment (no key — the alignment of the stack); «offset» — a shift from that place along the axes of the stack («x.toward»: start | end, logical; «y.toward»: top | bottom; «by» — a spacing token or logical pixels); «rotate» — whole degrees clockwise about the centre of the layer, mirrored in RTL. The layer may stick out of the stack; who clips it and where it catches a tap — «x-style.layout.layer». Legal only on a direct child of «Stack» and not together with «fill». No field — an ordinary layer, exactly as before 9.10.0.

NodePull.description: Pulls this child towards the START of the main axis of its parent by this much (9.10.0): the child and everything after it move, so the child lies OVER what precedes it and the parent gets shorter by the same amount. The gap of the parent stays: the overlap is «pull» minus the gap. A spacing token or logical pixels. Legal only where children follow one another: «Screen», «Column», «Container», and a «Row» without «wrap» and without «scrollable»; not together with «weight». Rules — «x-style.layout.pull». No field — the child stands where the flow puts it, exactly as before 9.10.0.

NodePin.description: Pins this child of the screen root to an edge of the screen: it leaves the scrolling body and stands, always on screen, while the body scrolls. «bottom» (9.12.0) — the bottom zone; read only on ONE node: the last child of the root, not counting the «NavBar»; rules — «x-style.layout.bottomZone». «top» (9.24.0) — the top zone, below the app bar; read on the children in a run at the start (right after the «AppBar» zone, or first), not with «bodyTop: screenTop»; rules — «x-style.layout.topZone». Anywhere else the field is not read and the node is an ordinary child. No field — the child scrolls with the body.

ShowOn.description: The width classes this node is shown on (9.18.0). Independent of «visibleIf»: the node is shown when BOTH hold. A node hidden by the class is hidden everywhere the contract asks «visible» (screen zones, app bar actions, list numbering, forms, stack layers, row weights). One or two classes, no repeats; all three is said by the absence of the field. No field — shown on every width. A reader older than 9.18.0 skips the field and SHOWS the node on every width.

WidthClass.description: The width class of the box the screen is drawn in (9.18.0): «compact» — narrower than 600 logical pixels, «medium» — 600…1023, «expanded» — 1024 and wider. The limits are data: «x-style.layout.widthClass.classes». Measured is the box of the screen root, not the window and not the device; one class per screen.

StyleOn.description: The style of the node on wider screens (9.18.0): the same fields as «style». Resolved from narrow to wide, field by top-level field: «style», then «medium» when the class is medium or expanded, then «expanded» when the class is expanded, and only then the first state of «styleWhen» whose condition holds. No field — «style» on every width. A reader older than 9.18.0 skips the field.

StyleUnset.description: Fields that are ABSENT on a wider class (9.19.0): a list of field names per class. Resolved with the layers, from narrow to wide: for each class the named fields are removed first, then the layer of that class is laid on. A field removed on «medium» stays removed on «expanded» until that layer names it again. Removed means «no field» — what the node would have without it. Rules — «x-style.layout.widthUnset». A reader older than 9.19 does not read the key: the field keeps the value from below.

NodeMotion.description: An endless motion of this node that never changes the layout (9.20.0): only a paint transform. «float» — the node drifts along «axis» by up to «amplitude» logical pixels; «pulse» — it breathes in scale and, optionally, opacity. One cycle lasts «duration» ms, the first starts after «delay» ms. The curve is a sine, not a field; the pose at any moment, the clock, «reduce motion», taps and clipping — «x-motion». No field — the node stands still, exactly as before 9.20.0.

amplitude.description: Largest shift from rest along each moving axis, in logical pixels.

duration.description: Length of one cycle, in milliseconds.

delay.description: Milliseconds the node stands at rest before its first cycle. No field — the cycle starts at once.

scale.description: Scale at the peak of the cycle, about the centre of the box; 1 — no change of scale.

opacity.description: Opacity factor at the peak of the cycle (multiplies the node own opacity). No field — opacity does not change.

duration.description: Length of one cycle, in milliseconds.

delay.description: Milliseconds the node stands at rest before its first cycle. No field — the cycle starts at once.

NodePressFeedback.description: Feedback of a pressable node to the finger (9.25.0). The reader gives it by itself — «x-pressFeedback»: a card or a list row scales to 0.97, a button to 0.96, an icon button, a ghost button and a navigation item fade to 0.7. «none» — no feedback on this node. No field — the feedback of the contract.

NodeVisibilityTransition.description: When «visibleIf» changes on the shown screen (9.33.0): «fade» — the leaving node fades out in place, the appearing one fades in after it — «x-visibilityFade». No field — at once.

NodeName.description: Editor-only name of the node in the document tree (9.29.0), like a layer name in a design tool: «Mission card» instead of «Container». Readers ignore it: it is not drawn, it is not part of the accessible name, it is not sent with events, and it is not translated. 1…80 code points after trimming the edges, not only spaces or invisible characters. Not on the screen root — the screen entry already names it. No field — the tree shows the widget name.

backdropBlur.description: Blur of whatever is painted UNDER the box of this node, clipped by its «radius» (9.20.0) — frosted glass on a card, a navigation bar or a button. Logical pixels, the standard deviation of a Gaussian blur; the node own background lies over the blur, the node and its children are never blurred. Not inherited. No field — no blur. Rules — «x-backdropBlur.style».

justify.description: How the children are placed along the MAIN axis (top to bottom) when the node is taller than its content: «start» — at the top, «center», «end» — at the bottom, «between» — the free space goes between the children. Free space exists only when the height of the node is named («style.height», «style.minHeight») or given by the parent (a layer with «fill»); a node as tall as its content has none, and the field changes nothing — it is not an error. «gap» stays the smallest distance between children. No field — «start». Rules — «x-style.layout.alignment». A reader older than 9.15.0 skips the field.

PressAction.description: Makes the whole container pressable (9.19.0): the same action form and the same execution path as a button. The container is a control when the action type is not «none» or the action carries «track». A control inside it (a button, an input, a choice option, a list row with an action) takes its own press — the container gets the rest of its box. No field — a plain container, exactly as before 9.19.0.

paramBindings.description: Parameter name → data-contract path. At press time the reader reads the path with the data scope of the node; a non-empty string replaces the literal in «params», anything else leaves the literal (the fallback).

carryRecord.description: Only on «navigate»: the opened screen gets the record scope of this node even when it is a page opened from outside a list row. Absent — the rule of 9.2.0.

haptic.description: Haptic feedback of the press (9.25.0) — a REQUEST to the host, like «track»: the reader never vibrates by itself, it hands the word to the host once per press, before the action and next to the analytics event. «light», «medium», «heavy» — an impact; «selection» — a change of choice; «success», «warning» — an outcome. Rules — «x-haptic». No field — no request.

ActionTrack.description: Analytics event of the press. Handed to the host once per press, before the action is performed, with the same source as the action. Not an action: any action may carry it.

PressLabel.description: Hidden accessible name of a pressable container (9.19.0): read first, before the text of its content. Required when nothing inside the container says anything without data.

LongPressAction.description: Long press of the node (9.26.0): the same action form and execution path as «action». It fires while the finger is still down, once it has stayed within the touch slop for the threshold of «x-longPress»; the press of «action» then does not happen. Only on a pressable container and on ListTile — never on a button. Requires «longPressLabel». No field — no long press.

LongPressLabel.description: Name of the long press action for assistive technologies (9.26.0): a named custom action of the node, the context menu key and Shift+F10. Required when «longPress» does something. Translatable.

ColumnPropsOn.description: Layout properties on wider screens — see «ScreenPropsOn».

scrollable.description: The row scrolls sideways and the children keep their natural width. Stronger than «wrap»: if both are true, the row scrolls instead of wrapping.

carousel.description: Turns the sideways scroll into a carousel: the scroll snaps to the cards and dots show the position. Rules — «x-style.layout.carousel». A reader older than 9.11.0 skips the field and shows the plain row.

perView.description: How many WHOLE cards the viewport shows; every card then has the same width — (viewport − inline-start padding − perView × gap − peek) ÷ perView — and its own «style.width» is not read. No field — cards keep the width a scrolling row gives them («x-style.layout.scrollableRow»).

peek.description: How much of the NEXT card shows at the inline end of the viewport. Read only with «perView». No field (or a token the theme does not declare) — «x-style.layout.carousel.card.defaultPeek».

indicator.description: The dots under the carousel: one per snap stop, the active one follows the scroll. No field or an unknown word — «x-style.layout.carousel.indicator.default».

stopPath.description: A NUMBER path of the data contract (a literal, never read from data) for the active snap stop, from 0 (9.32.0): written after a person swipes and the scroll settles, read at show and on change — the carousel moves to that stop. No field — nothing is written. Rules — «x-carouselStop».

RowPropsOn.description: Layout properties on wider screens — see «ScreenPropsOn».

direction.description: The direction the container stacks children in: «column» — one under another, «row» — side by side. The cross axis is the same as in the «Column» and «Row» widgets: in a column the child takes the full width of the container, in a row the children are centred vertically. Documents before 8.1.0 have no such field — there it reads «column».

align.description: The CROSS axis. In a column container — where the children that do not stretch stand horizontally (a node with its own «style.width» and the widgets of «x-style.layout.column.naturalWidth»; stretched children keep the full width); no field — «start». In a row container — how the children stand vertically; no field — «center». Both are the container as it was before 9.15.0 («x-style.layout.alignment.cross»).

justify.description: The MAIN axis: «start», «center», «end», «between» — where the free space along the direction of the container goes. In a row container the free space is the width the children leave. In a column container it exists only when the height of the node is named («style.height», «style.minHeight») or given by the parent (a layer with «fill»); otherwise the field changes nothing and is not an error. No field — «start». Rules — «x-style.layout.alignment».

ContainerPropsOn.description: Layout properties on wider screens — see «ScreenPropsOn».

columns.description: How many cells go in a row. The cell width is the same across the grid: (grid width − gaps) ÷ number of columns.

GridPropsOn.description: Layout properties on wider screens — see «ScreenPropsOn».

alignHorizontal.description: Where a layer narrower than the stack sits: «start» — at the start of the line (on the left in LTR), «end» — at the end.

alignVertical.description: Where a layer shorter than the stack sits: «start» — at the top, «end» — at the bottom.

initialTab.description: Index of the tab open when the screen is shown; counting from zero among ALL «Tab» children in document order — tabs hidden by «visibleIf» are counted too, so the index does not shift with data. If the named tab is hidden at that moment, the first visible tab is opened. After that the user switches tabs, and the document never learns about it.

required.description: Must be filled before a «requiresFilled» control of the screen is enabled («x-style.layout.form.required»). No field — not required.

pad.description: At least this many digits, zeros in front («05»), beside «format: countdownPart» (9.21.0). No field — as many digits as the number has.

source.description: Name of a collection from the data contract, for example «tasks». An item of that collection becomes available to the nodes inside the template under its own prefix: the «tasks» collection gives «task.title», «task.progress» and the rest of the task fields.

columns.description: How many copies of the template go in a row. No field — one per row. The cell width is computed exactly as in Grid: (width − gaps) ÷ columns.

carousel.description: Turns the sideways scroll into a carousel: the scroll snaps to the cards and dots show the position. Rules — «x-style.layout.carousel». A reader older than 9.11.0 skips the field and shows the plain row.

where.description: Draw only the records for which this condition holds (9.23.0), judged in the scope of THAT record over the outer scope. A record that does not pass does not exist for the layout: the grid packs, the carousel counts stops and dots of the cards drawn, numbers count the records drawn; «limit» takes the first records that passed. A comparison by «valuePath» with no value under it holds for every record («All»). No field — every record. Rules — «x-listFilter».

groupBy.description: Group the drawn records (9.26.0): records that follow one another with the same value under this path of the RECORD (for example «activity.day») form one group, and the SECOND child of the Repeater — the group header — is drawn before each group in the scope of its FIRST record. The order is the order of the data; groups are formed after «where» and «limit». Only a list in a column: with «columns» or a row direction the field is not published. No field — no groups, and the Repeater has one child. Rules — «x-repeaterGroup».

RepeaterPropsOn.description: Layout properties on wider screens — see «ScreenPropsOn».

Orientation.description: The axis of a «Spacer» or a «Divider», named after the SHAPE of the widget, not after the layout around it. «horizontal»: the divider is a horizontal line and the spacer adds HEIGHT — the form used inside a column. «vertical»: the divider is a vertical line and the spacer adds WIDTH — the form used inside a row. The container dictates the axis: a column needs «horizontal», a row needs «vertical».

spans.description: Own styles of parts of the text, keyed by the NAME of a template value of `content`. Every piece of the rendered string that comes from the place `{name}` is drawn with this style over the style of the node.

marker.description: List item marker before the text (9.17.0): «bullet» — «•» in the font of the text, «number» — the number of the item among consecutive numbered siblings and a dot, «none» or no field — plain text. The text hangs: its second line starts under the first line of the text, not under the marker («x-style.layout.listMarker»).

animateChanges.description: When the DATA change the value of this node while it is shown, the reader leads from the old value to the new one (9.21.0): a number of a text with a numeric format counts through the values between, a scale grows. Duration, curve, steps and when there is no transition — «x-valueTransition». No field — the value changes at once, exactly as before 9.21.0.

animateIn.description: When the node is SHOWN, its value grows from zero to its own (9.24.0): a number of a text with a numeric format counts up from 0 with the same curve, duration and steps as «animateChanges»; a ProgressBar or CircularProgress fills from empty. Shown — the first show of the screen, a screen shown again («back»), a node that appears (condition, width class, a new record). Rules — «x-valueAppear». No field — the value is there at once, exactly as before 9.24.0.

weight.description: Weight of this part, by word (9.17.0): the number is «x-style.layout.textEmphasis.weights». Stronger than the weight of the font style, whether the part names «typography» or takes the font of the text.

fontStyle.description: Slant of this part (9.17.0). No field — as the text has it; «normal» cancels an italic text for this part.

textDecoration.description: Line under or through this part (9.17.0), in the colour of the part. No field — as the text has it; «none» cancels the line of the text for this part.

parts.description: Styles of parts of the formatted number of this place (9.19.0, «x-money.parts»): `fraction` — the decimal separator and the digits after it, `currency` — the currency sign or code with its gap. weight.description: Weight of this part, by word (9.17.0): the number is «x-style.layout.textEmphasis.weights». Stronger than the weight of the font style, whether the part names «typography» or takes the font of the text.

fontStyle.description: Slant of this part (9.17.0). No field — as the text has it; «normal» cancels an italic text for this part.

textDecoration.description: Line under or through this part (9.17.0), in the colour of the part. No field — as the text has it; «none» cancels the line of the text for this part.

AmountPartStyle.description: Own style of one part of a formatted number inside a place (9.19.0). A named field replaces the field of the place style; a field that is not named stays as the place has it.

ImageRatio.description: Proportion of the image frame: a word of the list or an own «width : height» pair (9.9.0). It gives the HEIGHT of the box from its width, and only when «style.height» does not name it: a named size of the node box is stronger («x-style.layout.image»). A reader that does not know the value uses «16:9».

CustomImageRatio.description: Own proportion of the image frame: «width» to «height», two integers. Only their RATIO matters — «343 × 120» and «686 × 240» are the same frame. The ratio must stay within «x-style.layout.image.ratioRange»; a reader clamps what is outside it.

AltText.description: Description for a screen reader. A plain string — the text in the default language of the document, translated under the key of the field itself (`<screenId>/<nodeId>/alt`); or, from 9.19.0, a string of the document — a binding to data or a template, read and translated as any other. A wrapped literal equals the plain string. A reader older than 9.19 hears the plain string and reads an object as «no description».

glyphSize.description: Own size of the drawing, a whole number of logical pixels (9.16.0): the side of the square the icon is drawn in. Stronger than the word in «size» and than «style.typography»; the word stays in the document as the value a reader older than 9.16 draws. Rules — «x-style.layout.ownGlyphSize». No field — the size is the word in «size», exactly as before 9.16.0.

IconPath.description: Path in the data dictionary that holds the NAME of an icon of the contract icon set (9.19.0). The name of the document stays beside it: it is drawn when the data has no value (absent, null, an empty string) and by a reader older than 9.19. A name that is not in the set, or a value that is not a string, is an empty box of the same size. Never an address or a drawing. Rules — «x-iconFromData». No field — the icon of the document, exactly as before 9.19.0.

icon.description: Icon beside the label. Drawn by the rule «x-style.layout.iconBesideText»: same color as the label, a gap between them, centred on the line of the label. No field — no icon.

requiresFilled.description: Disabled while a required field of the screen is not filled («x-style.layout.form.filled», «…form.button»). No field — not read.

disabledIf.description: Disabled while the condition holds; with «requiresFilled» — when either holds («x-style.layout.form.button»). No field — not disabled.

confirm.description: How the press is confirmed (9.22.0). «swipe» — the button is drawn as a track with a thumb at the inline start; the action and its «track» run only when the thumb is dragged to the inline end past the threshold and released; released earlier, it returns. From the keyboard and for assistive technology it is an ordinary button named by its label: Enter and Space act at once. A disabled button does not move. Rules — «x-swipeConfirm». No field or an unknown word — an ordinary press, exactly as before 9.22.0.

IconPosition.description: Where the icon stands relative to the text beside it, in READING order: «start» — before the text (on the left in LTR, on the right in RTL), «end» — after it. The reader never swaps the two by itself; the direction of the script does. No field — «start» («x-style.layout.iconBesideText.defaultPosition»). Without an icon the field means nothing.

NodeZone.description: Puts this child of an «AppBar» into its LEADING zone (9.16.0) — in place of the built-in back arrow: an ordinary node with its own look, text, action and «visibleIf». Read on ONE child of the bar — the first one in document order that carries the field; it is not one of the two actions. Anywhere else the field is not read. Rules — «x-style.layout.appBarLeading». No field — the child is an action of the bar (an «IconButton»), exactly as before 9.16.0.

glyphSize.description: Own size of the drawing, a whole number of logical pixels (9.16.0): the side of the square the icon is drawn in. Stronger than the word in «size» and than «style.typography»; the word stays in the document as the value a reader older than 9.16 draws. Rules — «x-style.layout.ownGlyphSize». No field — the size is the word in «size», exactly as before 9.16.0.

disabledIf.description: Disabled while the condition holds; with «requiresFilled» — when either holds («x-style.layout.form.button»). No field — not disabled.

titleMaxLines.description: The largest number of lines of the title of the row (9.19.0); the rest is cut with an ellipsis at the end of the last line. No field — the text wraps without a limit, as before 9.19.0. Rules — «x-style.layout.listTileParts.maxLines».

subtitleMaxLines.description: The largest number of lines of the subtitle of the row (9.19.0); the rest is cut with an ellipsis at the end of the last line. No field — the text wraps without a limit, as before 9.19.0. Rules — «x-style.layout.listTileParts.maxLines».

color.description: Colour of the leading icon alone (9.19.0), stronger than the named colour of the node. No field — as before: the named colour or the built-in «primary» («x-style.layout.listTileParts.leading.color»).
Background of the tile: a token, a token with opacity («10 % of the brand colour») or an own colour.

radius.description: Radius of the tile: a token or a number. No field — «sm», the radius of the leading image.

size.description: Side of the square tile in logical pixels. No field — 40. The glyph keeps its size and stands in the centre.

ListTileLeadingTile.description: A tinted square (or circle — radius «pill») under the leading icon of a list row (9.19.0). The tile takes the place of the icon in the row; the gap to the texts is unchanged. Rules — «x-style.layout.listTileParts.leading.tile».

styleWhen.description: States of the trailing text (9.19.0): the first case whose condition holds is laid over «style» — the same mechanism as «styleWhen» of the node, evaluated in the same data scope («x-style.layout.partStyle»).

caption.description: Second line under the trailing text (9.19.0): one line, aligned to the end, «bodyS», secondary colour. Empty — no line. Rules — «x-style.layout.listTileParts.caption».

captionStyleWhen.description: States of the caption — the same rule as «styleWhen» of the trailing text.

PartStyle.description: Colour and typography of ONE part of a composite widget (9.19.0), named apart from the node: token or own value, like a field of «style». A field that is not named is not applied: the part keeps what it had (the named colour of the node or the built-in one). A token the theme does not know — the field is skipped. Rules — «x-style.layout.partStyle».

PartStyleCase.description: One state of a part: the condition of the same form as «visibleIf» and the style laid over the base style of the part while it holds.

thickness.description: Thickness of the track and of the fill: the height of the bar track, the stroke of the ring arc. A spacing token or a whole number of dp. No field (or a token the theme does not declare) — «x-style.layout.progress.defaultThickness». A ring never draws thicker than half of its diameter; zero draws neither the track nor the fill.

trackColor.description: Color of the track — the whole scale under the fill. No field (or a token the theme does not declare) — «x-style.layout.progress.defaultTrackColor».

gradient.description: Gradient of the fill, stronger than «color» while it resolves. It runs along the FILLED part: position 0 — the start of the scale, position 1 — the end of the fill («x-style.layout.progress.gradient»); the angle is not read. No field, an unknown token or unordered stops — the fill is the solid «color».

cap.description: Ends of the scale (9.21.0). «round» — the ends of the ring arc and of the bar track and fill are half-circles of the thickness, kept INSIDE the filled part: geometry — «x-style.layout.progressCap». No field or an unknown word — square ends of the ring arc and the theme «pill» radius of the bar, exactly as before 9.21.0.

animateChanges.description: When the DATA change the value of this node while it is shown, the reader leads from the old value to the new one (9.21.0): a number of a text with a numeric format counts through the values between, a scale grows. Duration, curve, steps and when there is no transition — «x-valueTransition». No field — the value changes at once, exactly as before 9.21.0.

animateIn.description: When the node is SHOWN, its value grows from zero to its own (9.24.0): a number of a text with a numeric format counts up from 0 with the same curve, duration and steps as «animateChanges»; a ProgressBar or CircularProgress fills from empty. Shown — the first show of the screen, a screen shown again («back»), a node that appears (condition, width class, a new record). Rules — «x-valueAppear». No field — the value is there at once, exactly as before 9.24.0.

segments.description: Cuts the scale into this many equal steps with a gap between them. A step is filled WHOLE or not at all: filled = floor(ratio × segments). Geometry, gap, rounding and the gradient — «x-style.layout.progressSegments». No field — the continuous bar.

currentColor.description: Color of the CURRENT step — the first one that is not filled yet. Read only with «segments». No field (or a token the theme does not declare) — the current step looks like every other unfilled one.

ProgressGlow.description: Glow of the FILLED part of the scale (9.25.0): a blurred copy of the fill under it, in its own colour or gradient — «soft» or «strong», numbers in «x-progressGlow». A bar with steps lights one step: the current one when «currentColor» paints it, otherwise the last step with any fill. It changes no layout and is not clipped by the own box of the node. No field or an unknown word — no glow, exactly as before 9.25.0.

size.description: Diameter of the ring when the node names no size of its own: «sm» — around a badge, «md» — a rank in a ring, «lg» — the main ring of the screen («x-style.layout.progress.ring.sizes»). A node with «style.width» or «style.height» takes its diameter from them instead (9.7.0).

labelFormat.description: Label in the CENTER of the ring: «percent» — «75%», «valueOfMax» — «3/4», «none» — nothing, and the center stays free for a Stack layer. Unlike the progress bar, the default here is «none»: the center is space the contract already promised to the document.

No field (or a token the theme does not declare) — «x-style.layout.progress.defaultThickness». A ring never draws thicker than half of its diameter; zero draws neither the track nor the fill.

trackColor.description: Color of the track — the whole scale under the fill. No field (or a token the theme does not declare) — «x-style.layout.progress.defaultTrackColor».

gradient.description: Gradient of the fill, stronger than «color» while it resolves. No field, an unknown token or unordered stops — the fill is the solid «color».

cap.description: Ends of the scale (9.21.0). «round» — the ends of the ring arc and of the bar track and fill are half-circles of the thickness, kept INSIDE the filled part: geometry — «x-style.layout.progressCap». No field or an unknown word — square ends of the ring arc and the theme «pill» radius of the bar, exactly as before 9.21.0.

Shown — the first show of the screen, a screen shown again («back»), a node that appears (condition, width class, a new record). Rules — «x-valueAppear». No field — the value is there at once, exactly as before 9.24.0.

labelTypography.description: Font style of the label in the center of the ring (9.17.0): a theme token or a token with overrides. No field — «x-style.layout.progress.ring.labelTypography». The label does not scale with the diameter.

labelColor.description: Colour of the label in the center of the ring (9.17.0). No field — «x-style.layout.progress.ring.labelColor».

icon.description: Icon beside the label, by the same rule as in a button («x-style.layout.iconBesideText»). No field — no icon.

widePlacement.description: Where the bar stands when the box of the screen is «medium» or «expanded» wide (9.18.0): «top» — at the top, its items inside the app bar of the screen or, without one, in a bar of their own; «bottom» — at the bottom on every width, as on a phone. On «compact» the bar is always at the bottom. The document does not change: the bar stays the last child of the screen root. Rules — «x-style.layout.wideNav». No field — «top».

float.description: The bar floats over the body (9.22.0): the body area reaches the bottom of the screen and the content scrolls UNDER the bottom zone; the reader adds the height of the zone at the end of the body content, so the last row scrolls clear of it, and puts the bottom safe inset OUTSIDE the box of the bar. The look of the pill is the style of the node (margin, radius, «backdropBlur», shadow). Read only where the bar stands in the bottom zone; on «medium» and «expanded» with the bar at the top it changes nothing. Rules — «x-style.layout.navFloat». No field — the bar as before 9.22.0.

badgeWhen.description: Show a dot on the icon of the item while the condition holds (9.22.0): the same form, check and missing-data rule as «visibleIf». Only a dot, no number; its colour is the core token «accent». The accessible name stays the label. Rules — «x-style.layout.navBadge». No field or a condition the reader does not understand — no dot.

required.description: Must be filled before a «requiresFilled» control of the screen is enabled («x-style.layout.form.required»). No field — not required.

maxLength.description: Limit of the entered text in Unicode code points; the reader cuts the input to it. A counter is drawn only with «counter».

lines.description: Visible lines of the field. More than one — a multiline field: Enter is a new line. No field — one line.

fieldRadius.description: Radius of the box of the field itself (9.19.0): a token or a number. No field — «sm». Rules — «x-style.layout.inputParts.field».

fieldBackground.description: Background of the box of the field (9.19.0). No field — «surface». Rules — «x-style.layout.inputParts.field».

fieldBorderColor.description: Colour of the border of the field at rest (9.19.0); the colours of focus and error replace it as before. No field — «border». Rules — «x-style.layout.inputParts.field».

fieldBorderWidth.description: Width of the border of the field in logical pixels (9.19.0), the same in every state. No field — 1. Rules — «x-style.layout.inputParts.field».

fieldHeight.description: Exact height of the box of a ONE-LINE field in logical pixels (9.19.0); the text is centred. Not read by a multiline field. No field — border, padding and the line. Rules — «x-style.layout.inputParts.field».

counter.description: Draws «count / maxLength» under the field, at the end of the row of the helper (9.19.0); the count is in Unicode code points. Read only together with «maxLength». No field — no counter. Rules — «x-style.layout.inputParts.counter».

InputValue.description: Where an input reads its value and writes the change: a path of the data contract. Read through the data layers («x-dataScope.layers»); written to the session of the reader and handed to the host. No literal and no fallback: an input without data is empty (a toggle is off).

TextFieldValueType.description: What a text field holds and writes. «number» — a path of type number, the numeric keyboard, a JSON number is written («x-style.layout.form.number»). No field or an unknown word — «string».

InputKeyboard.description: Intent of the screen keyboard of a text field, not a platform attribute: what each word becomes on the web and in Flutter is data («x-style.layout.inputs.textField.keyboards»). No field or an unknown word — «text». Not read by a multiline field.

FieldAffix.description: A mark inside the box of a text field (9.19.0): a short text («₴», «kg») or an icon, at the logical start («prefix») or end («suffix») of the box by the direction of the SCREEN. It is not part of the value and is never written. Rules — «x-style.layout.inputParts.affix».

required.description: Must be filled before a «requiresFilled» control of the screen is enabled («x-style.layout.form.required»). No field — not required.

defaultLocale.description: The language the document literals themselves are written in. It is absent from the translation table: that would be a second source of truth.

locales.description: Languages of the document in the order of the table columns. Includes `defaultLocale`. The order belongs to the editor, not to the reader: the reader finds the language for the locale of the user by the lookup rule of the compatibility policy (`localeMatching`), never by position in this list.

strings.description: Translations: language → (place key → text). The default language is not here — its text lives in the node literal.

Localization.description: Translation table of the document. A reader that does not understand it draws the literals as they are — that is, the default language.

LocaleTag.description: A BCP-47 language tag: a two-letter language code and an optional two-letter region (kk, ru, en-US).

LocalizationKey.description: A place in the document: «<screenId>/<nodeId>/<path to the field>». The key is bound to the place, not to the text, so editing the source string does not lose the translation.

ring.capAngle: thetaC = thickness / (diameter - thickness) radians — half the thickness over the middle radius
ring.ends: half-circles of the thickness whose centres stand thetaC inside the filled part from each edge
ring.arc: square-ended arc between the centres, from thetaC to sweep - thetaC
ring.dot: sweep <= 2 * thetaC — a dot of the thickness centred at thetaC
ring.full: ratio >= 1 — the whole ring, no ends, no seam
ring.gradient: along the filled part as without the field; a dot or an end takes the gradient colour at its centre

bar.radius: thickness / 2 for the track, the fill and every step — the theme «pill» is not read
bar.fill: ratio > 0 — max(thickness, ratio * track), at most the track; ratio <= 0 — nothing
bar.start: the inline start as without the field

progressCap.olderReader: skips the field — square arc ends, the theme «pill» bar

appBarScrolled.on: the app bar node only — no other node schema has the field
appBarScrolled.boxKeys: forbidden by the structure: the threshold is measured by the bar box
appBarScrolled.layer: last — over the base style, the width-class layers and the «styleWhen» state; merged by top-level fields

threshold.barBottom: the bottom edge of the app-bar zone from the top of the screen, the top safe inset included
threshold.bodyTop: the top of the BODY area from the top of the screen; with «bodyTop: screenTop» — 0
threshold.scrollTop: how far the body is scrolled, logical pixels

appBarScrolled.applies: only to the app bar that is the zone of the screen («screenAppBarOf»), of a page or a modal layer, by the scroll of ITS body
appBarScrolled.noZone: an app bar hidden by a condition or not the first child is no zone — the field is not read

titleShown.scrolled: the title block is drawn only while scrolled; at rest it keeps its place, invisible

appBarScrolled.children: no own «scrolled» style for the children of the bar; they inherit «color» as from the bar
appBarScrolled.transition: immediate; a short fade is up to the reader
appBarScrolled.editorCanvas: the bar at rest — the canvas never scrolls
appBarScrolled.statusBar: one «statusBarIcons» request per screen — not changed on scroll
appBarScrolled.semantics: the title stays in the accessibility tree while hidden at rest
appBarScrolled.unknownToken: a field whose token the theme does not know is dropped — the field under it stays
appBarScrolled.olderReader: skips both fields — the bar does not change on scroll and the title is always drawn

x-gradientGeometry.coordinates: normalized box: (0,0) top-left, (1,1) bottom-right, y grows downwards
x-gradientGeometry.axis: as CSS: 0 — to top, 90 — to right, 180 — to bottom, 270 — to left; from the middle of one edge to the middle of the opposite edge
x-gradientGeometry.diagonal: exactly CSS «to <corner>»: 45 — to top right, 135 — to bottom right, 225 — to bottom left, 315 — to top left. The gradient line passes through the center perpendicular to the diagonal joining the two OTHER corners, so the 50% isoline passes through those two corners and the target corner gets position 1
x-gradientGeometry.formula: for a box w×h and direction signs (sx, sy): end = (0.5 + sx·h²/(w²+h²), 0.5 + sy·w²/(w²+h²)), start is symmetric about the center; in Flutter: Alignment(2x−1, 2y−1)
x-gradientGeometry.direction: physical: not mirrored in right-to-left scripts

x-motion.clock: milliseconds since the node appeared on the shown screen; a node that appears again starts from zero
x-motion.phase: theta = 2 * pi * ((t - delay) mod duration) / duration; while t < delay the node stands at rest

float.yTowards: down — the vertical drift goes up first

pulse.scale: 1 + (scale - 1) * p, about the centre of the box

x-motion.reducedMotion: rest — the node stands where it stands without the field
x-motion.layout: unchanged: the box at rest sizes the parent, siblings do not move
x-motion.order: after the node own place («layer» offset and rotation): the shift goes along the screen axes, the scale about the centre of the box
x-motion.taps: promised inside the box at rest where the node is also drawn; outside that, readers may differ
x-motion.clip: no new clipping: whoever clipped the node at rest clips it while it moves
x-motion.olderReader: skips the field — the node stands at rest

x-backdropBlur.onPage: ignored by the reader; the editor does not publish it

radius.meaning: standard deviation of a Gaussian blur

x-backdropBlur.covers: exactly the area of the scrim («x-style.layout.modalLayer.scrim.covers»): every layer below, with its app bar and navigation bar
x-backdropBlur.order: the blur first, the scrim over it
x-backdropBlur.ownContent: the layer itself is never blurred
x-backdropBlur.reducedTransparency: not read: the blur is drawn as named
x-backdropBlur.withoutField: no blur — only the scrim, exactly as before 9.20.0

style.covers: the box of the node (border box), clipped by its «radius»
style.blurs: whatever is painted under that box: the backgrounds of ancestors, earlier siblings and stack layers, the page under a modal layer
style.order: the blur first, then the node own background (usually a translucent colour) over it, then its content
style.ownContent: the node itself and its children are never blurred
style.onRoleWidget: on «Button», «IconButton» and «Badge» the blur lies on the role surface — where its background and radius are
style.states: a style field like any other: «styleWhen» and «styleOn» may name or unset it

x-backdropBlur.olderReader: skips both fields — only the scrim, and no glass under a node

curve.name: ease-out-cubic

scale.fill: the ratio of the shown value and max, no step: the fill and the arc grow
scale.label: the numbers of «valueOfMax» — whole when both ends are whole; «percent» — of the shown ratio
scale.segments: filled steps follow the shown ratio — a step fills when the value passes it

whenNoTransition.firstShow: first frame of the node, a node that appears (condition, width class, a new record), a screen shown again
whenNoTransition.notANumber: the old or the new value is absent or not a finite number — «no data ↔ data» included
whenNoTransition.localeChanged: the language of the screen changed in the same step

x-valueTransition.dataOnly: only a change of the DATA under a path; a document with another literal is a new document — no transition
x-valueTransition.list: a template instance is tracked by its record; a new record is a first show
x-valueTransition.semantics: the screen reader hears the final value, not the values between

x-countdown.localeWithoutData: plain digits, zeros in front with «pad»
x-countdown.plural: the part is the number a plural word agrees with
x-countdown.sentence: the template composes the parts with its own words — order and words belong to the translation
x-countdown.now: the device clock; must be replaceable in tests

x-valueAppear.semantics: the screen reader hears the final value, not the values between

x-valueAppear.olderReader: skips the field — the value is there at once

x-segmentsTransition.sameStep: a change inside one step (U equal at both ends) moves nothing
x-segmentsTransition.stepFill: clamp(units - index, 0, 1) of the step, from its logical start
x-segmentsTransition.partialStep: a step with 0 < fill < 1 is drawn as its track or current colour with the fill over it, cut at fill * width, radius of the step kept

x-segmentsTransition.interrupted: a transition that starts from a value shown during another one starts from the whole steps of that value
x-segmentsTransition.label: the label runs by the step of x-valueTransition, as before
x-segmentsTransition.semantics: the screen reader hears the final value
x-segmentsTransition.reducedMotion: no transition: whole steps at once
x-segmentsTransition.olderReader: whole steps follow the shown ratio during the transition

x-progressGlow.value: one word of «strength»; no field or an unknown word — no glow
x-progressGlow.sigma: standard deviation of a Gaussian blur, logical pixels (CSS blur(sigma px), Flutter MaskFilter.blur(normal, sigma))
x-progressGlow.opacity: multiplies the alpha of the paint of the copy

x-progressGlow.bar: the fill, with its ends (cap); the track does not glow
x-progressGlow.ring: the arc of the fill, with its ends (cap); the track does not glow

x-progressGlow.clip: not clipped by the track, the step or the box of the node; clipped only by ancestors that clip, as a shadow
x-progressGlow.transition: follows the shown fill frame by frame (x-valueTransition, x-valueAppear, x-segmentsTransition)

x-shadowColor.background: the own background of the node after styleWhen and the width class (not inherited, not the role background)

x-shadowColor.solid: the colour of the background; its own opacity does not count — the layer carries it
x-shadowColor.gradient: the colour of the stop nearest to position 0.5; on a tie the earlier one
x-shadowColor.none: no background, an image background, or a colour that does not resolve — the layer keeps its own colour
x-shadowColor.roleWidget: on a widget with a role it goes with «shadow» to the surface of the role
x-shadowColor.olderReader: skips the field — the shadow keeps its own colour

x-pressFeedback.value: «none» — no feedback on this node; no field — the feedback below
x-pressFeedback.who: the node that performs the action of the press (the innermost control under the finger); its pressable ancestors give no feedback

kinds.card: a pressable container, a list row, an option and any other node that acts on press

x-pressFeedback.origin: the centre of the box of the node

x-pressFeedback.shortPress: a press shorter than «down» still reaches the pressed pose before it returns
x-pressFeedback.keyboard: no feedback: Enter and Space act at once
x-pressFeedback.swipeConfirm: no feedback: the gesture has its own
x-pressFeedback.reducedMotion: opacity only: every kind fades to 0.7, no scale
x-pressFeedback.layout: none: the scale is painting only, neighbours do not move
x-pressFeedback.composes: with node motion and the rotation of a layer: the press scale multiplies them
x-pressFeedback.editorCanvas: none — the node is selected there

x-haptic.unknown: an unknown word is no request
x-haptic.noDefault: no field — no request, on every widget and action (a section switch too)

x-longPress.fires: at the threshold while the finger is still down — not at release

x-longPress.afterFire: releasing the finger does nothing; «action» is not run
x-longPress.withoutLongPress: a long hold released in place is a press, as before 9.26.0
x-longPress.haptic: the «haptic» of the long press action, at the moment it fires; no field — no request

x-longPress.record: x-dataScope — the record of the instance, as for the press

accessibility.required: when the long press does something
accessibility.flutter: a custom semantics action named by «longPressLabel»
accessibility.web: the name on a hidden element referenced by «aria-describedby»; «aria-keyshortcuts» lists the keys
accessibility.keysAct: on the focused node, at once — no threshold

x-longPress.disabled: a container has no disabled state
x-longPress.editorCanvas: nothing — the node is selected there; the preview runs it, a held mouse button too
x-longPress.olderReader: skips the fields: no long press, a container with only a long press is not pressable

x-repeaterGroup.gap: the «gap» of the Repeater between every two drawn nodes, headers and records alike

x-sheetDismiss.grab: the handle drawn by the document or any point of the sheet

dismissible.value: «false» — no drag, no tap on the scrim, no Esc

dismissible.onPage: not read; the validator rejects it
dismissible.withoutField: dismissed as x-style.layout.modalLayer.dismiss and this block say

search.source: the collection the list read, under «Repeater.source», as the host gives it now: not filtered by «where», not bounded by «limit»
search.entity: then every other collection the document names for the same entity: the «source» of every Repeater with the same «item», screens in document order, depth first, each collection once

search.notAList: a collection that is absent or not a list holds no records

x-liveRecord.notFound: the instance keeps the last record it had: it neither empties nor goes back to the record of the navigation
x-liveRecord.notAShow: the stack, the screen-shown event, analytics and the show cause do not change; the screen keeps its scroll, carousels and inputs
x-liveRecord.valueTransition: a bound value that changed animates as any changed value does («animateChanges»)
x-liveRecord.handed: actions on the screen carry the refreshed record to the host

clickAfterFire.from: the release (pointerup) of the gesture that fired
notSwallowed: a click with no release of that gesture before it: a screen reader or the keyboard activated the node

x-modalEscape.listener: the top layer of the stack only
x-modalEscape.firstKeyDown: at most one step back: navigate.back of the top modal layer
x-modalEscape.autoRepeat: closes nothing (KeyboardEvent.repeat, Flutter KeyRepeatEvent): a held Esc closes one layer, not the stack
x-modalEscape.perKeyDown: one key down is at most one step back, however many layers there are

x-modalEscape.page: a page on top: Esc is not the reader’s
x-modalEscape.olderReader: a held Esc may close every layer of the stack

neverAnImage.read: as a URL parser reads it: leading U+0000–U+0020 stripped, tab, line feed and carriage return removed anywhere, the scheme compared case-insensitively

network.overBody: reading stops at the limit; the picture is the placeholder and a report (a declared length above the limit is refused before reading)

redirects.eachHop: the same rule judges every redirect target (the host’s decision when the host gave one); a refused target is not followed and the picture is the placeholder
redirects.web: the browser follows redirects of an itself and the reader cannot see them; the host page Content-Security-Policy (img-src) is the web counterpart

network.credentials: none: no cookies sent or stored, no authorization header, no client certificate of the app
network.referrer: none: the host page address is not sent (web: referrerpolicy="no-referrer" on every )
network.deadline: one picture, redirects included; past it the picture is the placeholder

decode.rule: the longer side is decoded at no more than maxDecodedSide pixels, the ratio kept; the size is read from the header before any pixel is made; a reader may decode smaller (at the size of the box)
decode.web: the browser decodes; the reader has no say in it

web.preload: none: no <link rel="preload"> outside the reader root
web.background: a CSS background image cannot carry a referrer policy: for it the host page Referrer-Policy applies

report.document: the address of the document, truncated to 120 characters, and the reason
report.data: the scheme and the host at most, and the reason: never the path or the query of an address from data (it may carry a token)

x-imageSource.olderReader: loads any absolute https: address, the IP literals and localhost included, and may send cookies and the Referer header

x-listBudget.order: document order, depth first: an instance counts before the lists inside its template, then the next instance of the same list, then the next list
x-listBudget.records: the records a list draws after «where» and «limit» (x-listFilter): a record that did not pass costs nothing
x-listBudget.over: the instance that would exceed the budget is not drawn, nor anything inside it, nor any instance after it on the screen
x-listBudget.report: one report per screen: how many instances were not drawn
x-listBudget.tree: the tree of the screen for its width class (propsOn applied), not what is shown now: a list hidden by visibleIf or showOn, in an inactive tab or a folded accordion counts the same
x-listBudget.groupHeaders: a group header (x-repeaterGroup) is not an instance and is drawn only with the instance it stands above; the lists inside it count right after that instance, before the lists of its template
x-listBudget.carousel: a card of a carousel is an instance like any other
x-listBudget.perList: unchanged: at most x-delivery.maxCollectionItems records per list, «limit» 1…50
x-listBudget.worstCase: every list draws its «limit» (without it 50) and every record starts a group; nested lists multiply; the tree, not what is shown

x-themeNumbers.boundsFrom: the schema of the theme contract artifact (its x-schema): the same numbers
x-themeNumbers.outside: a number below the minimum or above the maximum, or not finite (a JSON parser reads 1e309 as infinity; +infinity is above every maximum, −infinity below every minimum)

replacement.builtIn: the value of the same token and field in the built-in theme of the same brightness (x-compatibility.policy.partialThemeDefaults), when it has one

replacement.whyNotBuiltInForComposites: a part of a shadow or a gradient borrowed from another shadow or gradient would be a third value nobody wrote

x-silentText.olderReader: announces the transparent text as part of the name

x-modalFocus.hostTrap: a full trap only when the HOST asks (React: trapFocus): then Tab cycles inside every modal layer and is cancelled in a layer with nothing to focus
x-modalFocus.layersBelow: unchanged: inert, out of reach of the keyboard and a screen reader while the layer is shown
x-modalFocus.focusOnShow: unchanged: the focus moves to the layer when it appears and returns to the opener when it leaves
x-modalFocus.why: the document is not the one who decides that a keyboard user cannot reach the host page (WCAG 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap applies to the host page as a whole)

x-longPressWrite.shown: what changed is shown by the data: visibleIf, styleWhen, text — no state of its own

out.when: the condition of a shown node stops holding
out.layout: the node keeps its place while it fades and leaves the layout when it ends

in.when: the condition of a hidden node starts to hold

notTransition: the first show of the screen
a change of the language or of the width class («showOn»)

x-visibilityFade.notRead: a node without «visibleIf», the first child of the screen root that is an AppBar, a pinned node, a NavBar and a NavItem

measure.interrupted: a new value during a transition: the layout is held by the NEW final value from that moment
